blocks.html: The data required to create a gift card.

types.name: ModuleCreateGiftCard
types.description: The data required to create a gift card.

children.name: code
children.description: The unique redemption code for the gift card. If not provided, one is auto-generated.

children.name: value
children.description: The monetary value of the gift card.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The three-letter ISO currency code for the gift card's value.

children.name: expires_at
children.description: The expiration date of the gift card, or null if it does not expire.

children.name: reference_id
children.description: The ID of the resource this gift card is associated with.

children.name: reference
children.description: The resource type this gift card is associated with (e.g. "order").

children.name: line_item_id
children.description: The ID of the line item this gift card was purchased as.

children.name: customer_id
children.description: The ID of the customer to associate with the gift card.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs to attach to the gift card.
